description: This receipt is issued by The Whistle, a sports bar and grill located at 4909 W. 95th St., Oak Lawn, IL 60453. The header contains venue branding, the business address, website information, and restaurant identification details. The receipt includes POS transaction metadata such as a server identifier (Amanda V), check number (97), dining-area designation (In Mid), and a transaction timestamp. The financial section contains a subtotal, sales-tax calculation, and final transaction total. A dedicated gratuity section is printed at the bottom of the receipt, providing multiple suggested tip percentages and corresponding payment totals, along with a notice explaining that tip recommendations are calculated before taxes. The overall layout is representative of a United States full-service restaurant POS receipt, combining server tracking, check management, tax reporting, payment calculation, and gratuity guidance within a hospitality receipt format.
